description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You've been promoted to assist a mysterious supervisor who communicates via suspiciously well-timed text messages, infosphere newsreels, or even conveniently placed graffiti that quickly conveys exactly what you need to know to get the job done. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge], your benefactor sends you a clue that allows you to make your check with Society instead of any other skill, as well as roll twice and use the better result. If you Recall Knowledge using Business Lore, Corporate Lore, or Society, reduce the frequency of Assistant Regional Manager to once per 10 minutes.
